primary_title: Structural assembly of the megadalton-sized receptor for intestinal vitamin B12 uptake and kidney protein reabsorption
decision_basis: The cubam receptor is structurally assembled by direct association of cubilin with amnionless, anchoring ligand-binding cubilin to the membrane
limitations_preserved: Promote cubilin-AMN receptor-complex assembly only; preserve cubam multimeric architecture, peripheral cubilin semantics and renal/intestinal transport context, without SCI inference.

primary_title: AMN directs endocytosis of the intrinsic factor-vitamin B(12) receptor cubam by engaging ARH or Dab2
decision_basis: Amnionless FXNPXF signals interact with Dab2 and mediate endocytosis of cubam in complementary mutant and yeast-two-hybrid assays
limitations_preserved: Promote the AMN FXNPXF-to-DAB2 endocytic sorting branch; preserve functional redundancy of the two signals and cubam ligand/receptor context, without kinase or SCI inference.
